title: hebe dorrien-smithii
intro: Hebe dorrien-smithii, commonly known as the Blue Hebe, is a flowering plant species native to New Zealand. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Hebe dorrien-smithii include antimicrobial and antiviral effects, as well as potential anti-cancer and neuroprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
